note: In-memory patch set reproducing Open-BFME mods/dist/lotrbfme.exe from the vanilla workshop-1.03 exe. The on-disk exe is NEVER modified (its CRC is checked at LAN join); these patches are applied in-process by the Beacon hook DLL. ImageBase 0x00400000, IMAGE_FILE_RELOCS_STRIPPED=1 and DllCharacteristics=0 (no ASLR) so every absolute address is fixed. For all patched code sections raddr==vaddr, so file_offset == RVA == VA-0x400000.

header_changes.desc: OPTIONAL_HEADER.CheckSum 0x00FAE2D1->0 (invalidated; loader ignores for non-driver images)

features.title: Match-result and desync JSONL records
features.notes: Read-only logging. Two entry detours prepend code that reads GameLogic/VictoryConditions fields and appends one JSON line per match event to %BFME_RESULT_PATH% else %APPDATA% GameResult.jsonl via the exe MSVCR71 IAT (getenv/sprintf/fopen/fprintf/fputs/fflush/fclose/time). Writes no game state; not part of the lockstep checksum. Per-player output file; safe on a subset. WRITES A FILE.

features.title: Guest command send delay 92ms -> 0ms
features.notes: Timing change. On the ~30Hz client tick it calls Network::getCommandsFromCommandList (VA 0x00A828D0) so a guest command leaves on the engine tick that created it instead of the next 5Hz logic tick. Changes which frame a command is scheduled to, i.e. the shared command schedule. Authors mandate identical builds for every player (launcher MD5). Ships paired with 033, never alone.

features.title: Lost-command resend interval 2000ms -> 400ms
features.notes: In-place imm32 poke (no cave, no detour). Connection::Connection sets m_retryTime=2000ms; rewritten to 400ms. Changes retransmission timing of unacked commands. Authors mandate identical builds for every player.

features.title: Pause a replay with ctrl+period (replay-only)
features.notes: Replay-only: returns immediately unless TheGameLogic mode is GAME_REPLAY, so it cannot affect a match/skirmish/shell. Sets bit 1 of GameLogic+0x11C to pause the local logic tick. Client-local; not sim-affecting.

features.title: Fix terrain-track null-vertex-buffer crash
features.notes: Client render-path crash fix. Parks the track list in TerrainTracksRenderObjClassSystem (writes [this+0x10]) while the vertex buffer is null so flush takes its empty-list exit, preventing the access violation at EIP 0x0091DD7F. Not part of lockstep; safe even if only some players have it. Strongly recommended (prevents CTD).

features.title: Rotate/tilt/zoom camera in replays (replay-only)
features.notes: Replay-only: returns unless GAME_REPLAY. Writes InGameUI+0x12B4..0x12B7 camera flags, View pitch and TheGlobalData+0xA28 far-clip multiplier; reads the mod-bus magic at 0x01416000. Client-local; not sim-affecting.

features.title: Expose hidden Custom Graphics options tab
features.notes: Options-screen UI only (AptOptions::update ticks only while Options is open; RefreshNat click swallowed via shim swallow_ret=4). Graphics settings are client-local render quality. NOT functional without the bundled apt/options.big archive (sha256 f4188c7361ca63ad9e4c1e284266fbd3a2f81e5422ab6380e2be2326c8a8a1b5), which carries the nav-bar button and panel text: DATA FEATURE, out of scope for pure in-memory code patching; the two code detours are inert without it.
